thematiq: rondleiding door het appmenu,: thematiq: apps menu walkthrough, step 6, create
De plus in de bovenbalk begint een nieuw: The plus in the top bar starts a new document, spreadsheet, presentation or whiteboard. The file lands in your own folder and opens at once. The same buttons sit as the Create row at the bottom of the menu. More shows everything else Nextcloud can create. In Menu settings you switch the button and the row on or off separately.
